title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - APAC
description:
At Fluor, we are proud to design and build projects and careers. We are committed to fostering a welcoming and collaborative work environment that encourages big\-picture thinking, brings out the best in our employees, and helps us develop innovative solutions that contribute to building a better world together. If this sounds like a culture you would like to work in, you’re invited to apply for this role.


**Job Description**
-------------------


Scope


This position is responsible for consultation pertaining to HR practices and policies for assigned client groups or specific discipline. The responsibilities could include consultation on the portfolio of HR programs and initiatives or acting as a subject matter expert for an HR discipline with the intent to ensure maximum effectiveness of the Human Resources function.


Principal Job Duties \& Responsibilities


The Senior Recruiter will provide expert guidance to hiring managers, manage all stages of the recruitment process, and drive an exceptional candidate experience


This role requires strong business acumen, stakeholder management, and the ability to recruit effectively within competitive and specialized markets


Lead and execute full‑cycle recruitment for roles at all levels with a strong commitment to ethical hiring, process excellence, and global compliance standards


Manage an effective working relationship with the Recruitment Team and key stakeholders to ensure that recruitment services are meeting the needs of the company


Provide recruitment support and services to mitigate business exposure to employee related liabilities


Provide recruitment advice and market data to support new business proposals, remuneration reviews and growth strategies
 

Align, advocate, and communicate consistent recruitment process to internal and external stakeholders


Lead recruitment function or support HR recruitment manager, and departments in sourcing, interviewing/screening, making offers, and initial stages of on\-boarding candidates


Adhere to and support Fluor's Health, Safety \& Environmental and Sustainability Policies Effectively develop and apply the Core Skills to the job


This is an individual contributor role


**Basic Job Requirements**
--------------------------


Accredited four (4\) year degree or global equivalent in applicable field of study and seven (7\) years\* of work\-related experience or a combination of education and directly related experience equal to eleven (11\) years\* if non\-degreed; some locations may have additional or different qualifications in order to comply with local requirements


At least two (2\) years experience managing APAC (Asia Pacific Region) talent acquisition activities


Ability to communicate effectively with audiences that include but are not limited to management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitors


Job related technical knowledge necessary to complete the job


Ability to learn and apply knowledge of applicable local, state/province, and federal/national statutes and guidelines


Ability to attend to detail and work in a time\-conscious and time\-effective manner


**Other Job Requirements**
--------------------------


**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


• Accredited four (4\) year degree or global equivalent in HR, Psychology, Education, Business, Industrial Relations, Finance, or related field, with significant experience in Human Resources


• Professional in Human Resources (PHR) certification, or applicable HR accreditation


• Demonstrated problem\-solving skills of a complex nature


• Demonstrated ability to be discreet with confidential company and employee information


• Experience providing consultation to managers and HR staff


• Excellent written and oral communication skills


• Proficient computer and software skills to include the use of word processing, email, spreadsheets, and electronic presentations


• Broad knowledge of internal database applications for designated discipline


**To be Considered Candidates:**  

Must be authorized to work in the country where the position is located.


We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by governing law.

title: GM - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Company Description** **Assystem** provides engineering, project management and digital services to optimise the performance and safety of critical infrastructure throughout its lifecycle.


The company first came to India having acquired Stup Consultants Pvt Ltd in **2021** and **L\&TIEL** in **2024\.** The company combines its globally recognised expertise in complex project management, with deep\-rooted local experience cross full spectrum of infrastructure – from energy, transportation and urban development to water. Today, **Assystem** has a strong community of 1,500\+ multidiscipline engineering experts connected across 8 offices in India.


The Assystem Group is one of the world’s leading independent nuclear engineering companies, ranked among the top three globally, with 60 years of experience in complex and highly regulated environments. With 8,000 experts across 13 countries, Assystem supports the development of low\-carbon energy.


For company profile, please visit the website :\- https://assystem\-india.com/

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for an experienced **Talent Acquisition** professional to lead and drive the organization's talent acquisition strategy, will be responsible for developing effective recruitment strategies, building a strong talent pipeline, and ensuring the timely acquisition of quality talent across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement strategic talent acquisition plans aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment activities, with a focus on mid\-to\-senior\-level and leadership hiring.
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce requirements and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline through direct sourcing, networking, and recruitment platforms.
* Drive recruitment for critical and niche positions within defined timelines.
* Strengthen stakeholder relationships and ensure a seamless recruitment process.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, hiring timelines, and overall recruitment effectiveness.
* Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to attract high\-quality talent.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the talent acquisition team.
* Strengthen employer branding and enhance the organization's talent attraction strategy.
* Leverage Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment technologies to streamline hiring processes, track candidates, and improve recruitment efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment policies and deliver a positive candidate experience.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes to enhance efficiency and hiring outcomes.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
* **18\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition**, preferably in the Energy, Engineering, EPC, or Infrastructure sectors.
* Proven experience in leading talent acquisition functions and developing recruitment strategies.
* Strong experience in mid\-to\-senior\-level and leadership hiring.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong team leadership and people management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment requirements and deliver results within defined timelines.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Talent Acquisition
* Leadership Hiring
* Stakeholder Management
* Talent Pipeline Development
* Team Leadership
* Recruitment Analytics
* Employer Branding
* Process Improvement

  

**Qualifications**  

MBA \- HR

 **Additional Information**  

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an energetic and target\-driven **HR Recruiter specializing in BPO hiring**. The recruiter will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment for **Voice, Non\-Voice, Customer Support, Sales, Collections, Back Office, and other BPO roles**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with bulk hiring, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, follow\-ups, and achieving monthly joining targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **end\-to\-end recruitment** for BPO and customer service positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, databases, WhatsApp groups, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening based on communication skills, experience, salary expectations, location, shift flexibility, and joining availability.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and operations/hiring managers.
* Handle **bulk and volume hiring** requirements.
* Maintain regular candidate follow\-ups from screening through interview, selection, documentation, and joining.
* Minimize candidate dropouts and improve interview\-to\-joining conversion.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and update ATS/CRM/recruitment trackers daily.
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline for ongoing BPO requirements.
* Coordinate walk\-in drives and recruitment campaigns when required.
* Achieve assigned **daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets**.

Candidate Requirements

**Education:** Graduate preferred; undergraduates may be considered based on experience and communication skills.

**Experience:** Fresher or 0–3 years of recruitment experience. Candidates with BPO/Bulk Hiring experience will be preferred.

**Required Skills:** Good communication and interpersonal skills, candidate sourcing and screening ability, understanding of BPO hiring, strong follow\-up skills, basic Excel/Google Sheets knowledge, ability to work with recruitment targets, and familiarity with job portals and social recruiting.

Preferred Experience

Experience hiring for processes such as **International Voice, Domestic Voice, Customer Support, Telecalling, Sales, Collections, Technical Support, Chat/Email Support, and Back Office** will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* BPO Recruitment: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience supporting financial services, compliance, supervision, legal, or highly regulated applications.
* Experience with: AWS Cloud Operations DevOps and CI/CD concepts Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Python automation development
* Knowledge of ETL platforms such as Informatica, AWS Glue, IDMC, or equivalent.
* Experience building operational dashboards, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting mechanisms.
* Knowledge of Mainframe environments and scheduling integrations is a plus.
* Proven track record of identifying automation opportunities and reducing operational overhead through scripting and process improvements.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset

**In\-Office Collaboration**

* We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week.
